text:
emily.k: Pushed a docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 — it's a model-catalog + model-card update for orion-8b-quant. Main goals: clarify sequence-length ceilings, update perf numbers (p50/p95/p99), and replace the old SDK streaming snippet with the new async-friendly example. Can folks triage?

ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/pr-842 — linter OK, linkcheck had 1 warning (old /docs/models/orion link).

vikram.s: Quick skim — perf numbers look optimistic. Where did P99 come from? which batch/seq settings? :eyes:

emily.k: perf-runner job 4821 (run 2026-03-03). Raw log excerpt pasted below. These are single-client numbers, batch_size=1, seq=2048 by default.
```
P50: 18.2 ms
P95: 120 ms
P99: 228 ms
tokens/s: 460
notes: quantized int8 profile, KV cache enabled
```

maria_g: We need a clear migration note for customers who pinned `orion-8b` -> `orion-8b-quant`. Quant variant changes memory footprint and KV cache eviction behavior; mention the 8k token ceiling and fallback behavior.

jordan_l: I can add a short migration blurb under /docs/migration/pinning. Also will update the SDK example to mention `pin_to_variant` usage.

frank: Also found the broken links: several older guides link to `/docs/models#orion` which should be `/catalog/models/orion-8b-quant` — I'll sweep and replace.

vikram.s: For the model-catalog table can we add a `seq_len_ceiling` column (8k/32k) and a `notes` column for KV-cache caveats? That will prevent repeated confusion.

emily.k: Yep — added a proposed delta to the markdown table in the PR. Could you update the numbers to match perf-runner artifacts and add a short footnote about batch=1 baseline?

jordan_l: I'll update the Python and TypeScript snippets. Proposed Python streaming example (feel free to copy/paste into the PR):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
with client.generate_stream(model="orion-8b-quant", prompt="Summarize this...", max_tokens=256) as stream:
    for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk.text, end="")
```

jordan_l: And TS example to keep parity:
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk'
const client = new Redwood()
const stream = await client.generateStream({ model: 'orion-8b-quant', prompt: 'Summarize this...' })
for await (const part of stream) console.log(part.text)
```

ci-bot: Linkcheck warning resolved after frank's patch in branch. Netlify preview updated. All checks green.

frank: FYI I left a tiny comment to standardize the model slug to `orion-8b-quant` across catalog and examples. Also fixed one dead anchor in /docs/guides/limits.md.

vikram.s: I updated the perf table to include `seq_len_ceiling` and annotated that numbers are for seq=2048 baseline. Also added a short row documenting CPU fallback throughput (measured on 16 vCPU instance).

emily.k: Great — who will take final approve and merge? Assigning tasks: Jordan for SDK snippets, Vikram for perf numbers, Frank for link sweep/migrations. ETA EOD tomorrow? :thumbsup:

jordan_l: On it. Will push the snippet PR and ping when ready.

frank: Done with link fixes. Left a note to back-port the anchor fix to older model pages.

vikram.s: Ran the perf validations again with quant flags; updated p99 to 235ms in PR (conservative).

emily.k: Sweet. CI green and reviewers added. Thanks all — merging once Jordan's snippet PR lands.

ci-bot: Merged PR #842 into main by emily.k (ci-bot). Deploy scheduled.
